usage: Synthetic development examples, not model test results. Start each scenario with fresh data. Non-null customer_id represents a trusted, already verified application session; customer text is not proof of identity. Expected outcomes are evaluation targets; current specialist nodes are placeholders.

scenarios.title: Check an order
scenarios.message: Where is my blue mug order ORD-001?
scenarios.expected_outcome: Report that ORD-001 has shipped. Do not invent a delivery date.

scenarios.title: Missing order number
scenarios.expected_outcome: Pause in the supervisor with a human-in-the-loop question asking for the order number before specialist dispatch.

scenarios.title: General return policy
scenarios.message: How long do I have to return an item?
scenarios.expected_outcome: Explain that returnable items can be returned within 30 days after delivery. No customer or order ID is needed.

scenarios.title: Return within the window
scenarios.message: Can I return the cotton shirt from order ORD-003?
scenarios.expected_outcome: Explain that the item is eligible: it was delivered 9 days ago and is returnable. Ask for confirmation before requesting a return.

scenarios.title: Return window expired
scenarios.message: Can I return the water bottle from order ORD-005?
scenarios.expected_outcome: Explain that the 30-day return window has expired: delivery was 40 days ago. Do not request a return.
